question: The English novel 'Morning Face' is written by:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mulk Raj Anand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand** was one of the pioneers of **Indian English literature**.
 
• He is known for his depiction of the lives of the **poor and marginalized sections** of Indian society.
 
• His works often address issues like **caste discrimination, poverty, and social injustice**.<
